course.title: Building Engineering Systems
course.department: Department of Building Engineering and Construction Management

content.value: An ice plant produces 10 tons of ice per day at $0 \%$ using water at room (12) temperature of $20 ^ { 0 } C .$ Estimate the power rating of the compressor motor, if the COP of the plant is 2.5 and overall electro-mechanical efficiency is 90%.

topics: Introduction to Building Control System, types of control and applications, human comfort, relative humidity and psychrometric chart, HVAC fundamentals. heating systems, modes of heat transfer, ventilation and air conditioning, air conditioning load calculations, ducting system and duct design, cooling system, refrigeration system and cycle, control loop, HVAC performance testing, adjusting and balancing (TAB), Cleanroom Performance Testing (CPT), standards, facilities management and maintenance. plumbing and sanitary systems, drainage system design and construction, water supply design, plumbing fixtures, plumbing testing, MEP coordination, MEP sustainability implications.
_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2015
classification_notes: প্রশ্নটি হিট পাম্প/কুলিং সিস্টেমের COP, তাপ বহন এবং শক্তি ব্যবহার সম্পর্কিত যা HVAC fundamentals ও এয়ার কন্ডিশনিং লোড ক্যালকুলেশনের (Topic 1) অধীনে পড়ে।
verification_notes: প্রশ্নটি রেফ্রিজারেটর সিস্টেমের COP এবং শক্তি ব্যবহার নিয়ে যা HVAC fundamentals-এর অংশ হওয়ায় টপিক ক্লাসিফিকেশনটি যথাযথ।
